acceptedScope: Recursive mathematical binder classification and direct compiled TYPE/VALUE memberships for21 selected declarations; not an exhaustive transitive mathlib body audit.

binderClassification.universesAndStructures: Omega/Seed/X/Z universes are explicit and general. MeasurableSpace instances supply event structures; IsProbabilityMeasure means probability normalization, not a concealed regret claim. R003/C2 deliberately lack ambient structure/probability hypotheses.
binderClassification.data: Measures, target/tape maps, time/horizon, subordinate fields, predictions and policy functions are mathematical data.
binderClassification.regularity: hY/hS/hX ordinary measurability; hp is joint measurability on the product domain; hP is exact measurability in the supplied raw field. Their expansion concerns measurable preimages, not the desired independence or excess conclusion.
binderClassification.law: hlaw requires identical distributions for all times; hind is mutual indexed independence, recursively a finite-family product event condition; hseed is independence from a single whole-process product-valued map, not coordinatewise independence.
binderClassification.causalDomain: hF is sigma-field inclusion and hP exact F-measurability; current/future information is excluded by literal G_t. No Monotone F is present.
binderClassification.feasibility: hb/hpb in R006 are per-time AE interval bounds. R007 hpb universally quantifies time, every seed and every history, with legal-cube antecedent; this is an admissibility premise, not a supplied expected-risk conclusion.
binderClassification.helperHypotheses: R001 hseed and hXY are natural block-independence hypotheses; its conclusion is a different regrouping. No seed-past/current or prediction-current independence is supplied to R002/R004/R006/R007.
absentHiddenPremises: No one-step or cumulative regret inequality supplied
No final equality supplied through a structure field or callback
No L2 premise on final predictions
No theorem-valued witness smuggled through the private information definition

definitionDisclosure: All three complete bodies are present in neutral packet and pass actual-definition rfl equality. C0/C1 are total real integral/sInf operations and need theorem-domain assumptions for ordinary expectation reading. C2 is the literal raw comap, with strict finite range and seed present at t=0.

compiledDependencyEvidence.method: Compiled ConstantInfo.type and value? allowOpaque=true; getUsedConstantsAsSet independently for each. Counts are per-row constant-set memberships, not raw AST occurrence counts.
compiledDependencyEvidence.limits: Direct memberships only; a name in TYPE is not a proof-body edge. VALUE contains elaborated proof syntax, including types in proof terms; it is not a minimal causal-use analysis or an exhaustive recursive upstream proof audit.

reuseFindings: Existing expected-fixed definitions, attained-minimum theorem, cumulative decomposition and variance square identities are reused unchanged. No duplicate benchmark definition is added.

New independent private-tape regrouping and subordinate-information interfaces extend the deterministic-history route. Exact-name and theorem-memory searches are supporting search evidence, not a proof of global API uniqueness.

No proof irrelevance shortcut equates different propositions; no universe-zero specialization. Earlier failed equality probes are retained as helper failures, not mathematical acceptance.
